blocks.html: Don't miss our Grand Opening Event happening at our newest location in Commerce City, July 7th 11am-4pm.
We're happy to have our eighth convenient location & can't wait to share some of our most exclusive deals,
prizes, and more! Our ribbon cutting ceremony with the Commerce City Chamber of Commerce will start off
the event at 11AM followed by a TON of fun.
FLO 107.1 will be there set up with a LIVE DJ, doing shout outs, giveaways & playing the hottest new hits!
Have you ever wanted to get chauffeured around with your friends in a CUSTOM, decked out Mercedes Sprinter Van?
Starbuds will be RAFFLING off 2 hours for you and your friends to go wherever you want in Colorado, so make to
sure stop by the store to enter.

Not only will we be giving away a TON of cool gifts, we will have one of a kind deals from us and our excluive Vendors (High Tech, Ripple by Stillwater & Taste Budz) who will be doing Buy One Get One for a Penny deals that are OUT of this world!
We cant wait to see you there!
